sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that rising material costs are putting pressure on your foundry, and we remember that you continued supplying us at the old price during the earlier supply crisis; we value that commitment and our long relationship. Our order volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with you, and our forecast is rising; we also recognise that your costing has not kept pace with actual material prices. We can’t accept the proposed increase, but would welcome a discussion of a price approach that better reflects those costs while helping us stabilise terms; when would suit you to discuss this?

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01); our agreement provides for 90 days (ctr:4600070110).

On this basis we propose: EUR 125.83 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We deeply value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your confirmation of the 8150 units annual volume.
Building on your proposed 14-day payment terms, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €133.70 per unit, and we would welcome a meeting to discuss this further.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving toward us again; we appreciate the adjustment and value the long-standing relationship, especially your continued supply through the earlier crisis. Our volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with you, and our forecast is rising. Our proposal moves toward you again, including terms that take account of how important the timing of payment is for you.

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 126.53 (po:4500014428-10, po:4500014358-10, po:4500014313-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 128.19 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €131.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We did not know that - a fair point.
We value our long-standing partnership and your commitment to the 8150 units annual volume.
To move forward, we are prepared to offer a further reduced price of €131.50 per unit, maintaining the 14-day payment terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving your offer further and for recognising the point about the price history; we appreciate both, and remember that you continued supplying us at the old price during the earlier crisis. We understand that timely payment matters to your family business, and that your costing has not kept pace with actual material prices. Our full demand for this part over the term is with you, and our forecast is rising; we have moved our proposal toward you again in the hope of stabilising the arrangement.

Our forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 129.18 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
